answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that burns like an ember if it misbehaves, and earn a summit reputation score only through verified work for real principals over time. A newcomer starts as a sparrow with tiny limits; raising limits demands costly stake plus a history of honest attestations. Spinning up thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, while honest agents keep their stake and climb. Sybils cannot cheaply buy the track record that unlocks influence.
